member.name: T:RedSnail.WaterTool.HullWaterExclusionVolume
member.summary: Excludes the water surface inside a mesh hull rather than an approximated box volume. Place on the same GameObject as the ModelRenderer. The physics collision mesh is extracted once and uploaded to the GPU as a triangle list; only the WorldToLocal matrix is updated each frame as the object moves or rotates.

member.name: P:RedSnail.WaterTool.HullWaterExclusionVolume.LocalTriangles
member.summary: Triangle vertices in model LOCAL space, flat (v0,v1,v2, v0,v1,v2 …).

member.name: P:RedSnail.WaterTool.HullWaterExclusionVolume.LocalAABB
member.summary: AABB of all local triangles, used for early GPU rejection.

member.name: T:RedSnail.WaterTool.WaterBody
member.summary: Defines a discrete body of water that participates in a renderer-driven water system. Provides volume bounds, a physics hull for buoyancy/swimming, and renderer inclusion in one component. Requires a WaterQuadRenderer present in the scene to produce a visible water surface.

member.name: T:RedSnail.WaterTool.WaterExclusionVolume
member.summary: Suppresses water surface rendering inside a volume. Has no effect on the physical water hull so buoyancy and swimming still work within the excluded area. Intended for enclosed spaces that sit in water, such as the interior of a boat or submarine.

member.name: M:RedSnail.WaterTool.WaterManager.AddRipple(Vector3,System.Single,System.Single,System.Single)
member.summary: Spawn an expanding ripple on the water surface at the given world position.
member.param: Where the ripple originates (only XY is used).
Scales the height of the ripple (1 = a normal splash).
Ring spacing — smaller = more rings. Pass <= 0 to use the manager's Default Wavelength.
Ring size — larger = a bigger, broader ripple. Pass <= 0 to use the manager's Default Ring Width.

member.name: M:RedSnail.WaterTool.WaterManager.ComputeRippleHeight(Vector2)
member.summary: CPU evaluation of the ripple vertical displacement at a world XY position. MUST mirror ComputeRipples() in advancedwater.shader so physics matches visuals.

member.name: T:RedSnail.WaterTool.WaterRippleEmitter
member.summary:
Emits water ripples when this object crosses the water surface, and optionally while it moves across it. A generic, dependency-free alternative to the entry ripple built into — drop it on anything that doesn't have a Buoyancy component (players, NPCs, projectiles, debris...).
Velocity is derived from the object's own position delta, so it works with any movement system (CharacterController, custom controllers, animation, etc.) and needs no Rigidbody.
